metadata.desc: LLM tools for fetching Bilibili video subtitles and interpreting video content. Automatically recognizes Bilibili links, BV IDs, and b23 short links in messages.

bilibili_cookie.description: Bilibili Cookie (optional, but enables higher-quality subtitles)
bilibili_cookie.hint: See the README for a detailed guide.

max_subtitle_length.description: Maximum returned subtitle length (characters). 0 means no limit
max_subtitle_length.hint: Set to 0 to return the full subtitle; a larger value increases token consumption

auto_send_txt.description: Automatically save subtitles as a txt file and send it to the chat
auto_send_txt.hint: When enabled, a txt file is sent to the group every time subtitles are extracted

enable_read_tool.description: Enable the bilibili_read in-depth interpretation tool (high token consumption)
enable_read_tool.hint: When disabled, bilibili_read is not registered in the LLM tool list. When enabled, the bot reads the full subtitle text before summarizing whenever a user asks for a video interpretation

read_max_subtitle_length.description: Maximum subtitle length returned by the bilibili_read tool (characters). 0 means no limit (full read-through)
read_max_subtitle_length.hint: Full subtitles can be very long; set an upper bound to prevent context overflow. 0 or a very large value is recommended
